style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

aestheticCriteria.observableSuccess: A readable crafted timber deck with softened corners, convincing front/outer thickness and supporting structure. Useful native construction improvements are rewarded. Preserve occupied3x3scale and clear dock access; avoid lumpy over-rounded walking surfaces or structural detail that reads as trim clutter.
notLocked: target exact silhouette or board spacing

aestheticCriteria.observableSuccess: Honey/golden top wood with restrained amber contrast and warm dark side/end grain; visibly richer than the source without becoming neon yellow, orange plastic or a bright striped warning pattern. Keep palette family and enough contrast against existing dock family/people.

Soft broad edge highlights explain board volume and separate front/side planes. One horizontally neutral lighting/material treatment works unchanged in N/E/S/W. No preferred left/right light, hard directional ground shadow, clipped highlight rim, black underside block or view-dependent grade/fitting.

Long grain, occasional subtle knots and readable fixing marks feel purposeful, differ across boards and remain low-contrast enough for a walking platform. At phone scale the wood should still read as crafted boards, not noisy scratch lines. Details must be native geometry/material/texture resources with editable source, not a target card.

At128logicalpx/cell and reduced phone presentations all4facings retain deck identity and coherent thickness. Intentional plank grooves are allowed; no accidental tears, coplanar flicker, protruding nail obstacles, black patches, exposed connector ends, holes at an accepted functional transfer, colored halo or filtering-dependent seam. Diagnose pre-existing neighbor issues separately.
